notes.title: Playtest Sign-ups Now Open + Tokyo Game Show
notes.content:
[p][b]Comrades![/b][/p][p]
The day has come. The Republic of Sobakistan invites citizens from all over the world to participate in the secret closed testing of our game's demo version.
If you are interested, please press the appropriate button.
The event will take place in October — stay alert and don’t miss it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662942/1d8c36e09eefd0d7b174b797e79750482aafaf2c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Also, the official delegation of the Republic of Sobakistan will visit Tokyo to take part in Tokyo Game Show 2025.[/b][/p][p]If you’re attending — come play the demo in person!
[b]Hall 11, Indie Area, Booth E-62.[/b]
[b]Long live Sobakistan![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45662942/52f1f078dc93a45da4501e6e9c1ce6dd881b4b50.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][/p]
